newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 3.4 bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 3.4 bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 3.4 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
It accepted bids for 43.8 billion francs in new liquidity, 3.4 billion more than the 40.4 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on September 20.
The Bank of France said it allocated 13.1 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.2 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 30.7 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 12.6 percent of this demand.
